data.label: Existing Git repository
data.description: Existing repository hosting the synthetic pull request. Preserved unchanged; the reviewer gets read-only access to the PR diff and relevant files only. Git host to be confirmed.

data.label: PR reviewer job
data.description: Event-triggered Code Engine job: fetches the authorised diff and bounded related files as text only (no checkout build, no code execution), builds the prompt, calls the model and maps findings to changed-line anchors. Returns draft comments; holds no push/merge permission.

data.label: Repository read token
data.description: Stores the least-privilege, read-only repository credential; the job reads it at runtime via IAM service ID. No secrets on the diagram.

data.label: Scope & content guard
data.description: Application responsibility inside the reviewer job: enforces file/size allow-list, treats repository content as untrusted (prompt-injection), strips secrets, and rejects comments not anchored to changed lines.
data.service: IBM Cloud Code Engine (in reviewer job)

data.label: Review model
data.description: Foundation model inference analysing the diff. Model ID, regional availability, plan and access are unverified. Local test uses scripted mock responses.

data.label: Human reviewer
data.description: Developer who reviews and approves draft line-linked comments before anything is published.

data.label: Audit & run logs
data.description: Records each review run (PR ref, files fetched, model call metadata, outcome) without storing source code bodies. Retention to be decided.

brief.application: Use IBM Cloud for this synthetic architecture qualification. Review a synthetic pull request from an existing repository. Retrieve only the authorized diff and relevant files, analyze it with AI, and draft review comments linked to changed lines. Preserve the existing repository. Never push, merge or execute repository code. Draw the complete end-to-end architecture with concrete service choices and connected flows. Explain the first local test, distinguish mocked model behavior from actual model validation, and ask one useful missing-decision question. Do not reduce this application to storage to satisfy generator coverage. Do not invent successful deployment or approved region/account access.

requirements.statement: The reviewer must only read the authorised PR diff and relevant files and must never push, merge, or execute repository code.
requirements.rationale: Prevents supply-chain damage and code-execution risk from untrusted PR content.
requirements.basis: User: 'Preserve the existing repository. Never push, merge or execute repository code.'

requirements.statement: Each AI review comment is a draft anchored to a changed line in the PR and requires human approval before publication.
requirements.rationale: Unanchored or auto-posted comments erode trust and could leak hallucinated findings.
requirements.basis: User: 'draft review comments linked to changed lines'

requirements.statement: Local tests use scripted model responses; review quality must be separately validated with real watsonx.ai calls against an agreed defect set (proposed).
requirements.rationale: Mocks prove plumbing, not model quality.
requirements.basis: User: 'distinguish mocked model behavior from actual model validation'

decisions.subject: design.ibm-cloud-ai-pull-request-reviewer-read-only-draft-comments
decisions.title: IBM Cloud AI pull-request reviewer (read-only, draft comments)
decisions.context: End-to-end sketch: existing repository → Code Engine reviewer job (read-only token from Secrets Manager) → scope guard → watsonx.ai → draft line-linked comments for human approval, with audit logs. Assumptions: Git host, region, model ID and comment write-back are undecided; no deployment, region or account access is verified. Repository code is never executed, pushed or merged.
